summary: The diff implements Proxy [[Construct]] in construct.rs, following the spec steps 1-11 in order. It calls ValidateNonRevokedProxy via p.validate_non_revoked(agent)? and GetMethod(handler, "construct") via ops::get_method with ?. When the trap is undefined it returns ops::construct(target, args, Some(new_target)) with ?. Otherwise it builds the args array with create_array_from_list, calls the trap with ops::call(trap, handler, [target, argArray, newTarget]) with ?, and throws a TypeError if the result is not an Object. The not-implemented error is removed because the path is now complete. Each step is a comment above its code. The only non-spec change is renaming the unused parameter `o` to `_o`, which is needed to avoid an unused warning. The assert steps (3 and 5) are not coded, which is acceptable since asserts have no observable effect. Nothing is special-cased, faked, or swallowed. The gate report shows build, clippy, and all 58 target tests passing.
